chapters.reason: Llamba is described as scalable recurrent models implemented via architectural changes (Mamba), i.e., explicit architectural recurrence across layers.
The work involves cross-architecture distillation converting Transformer checkpoints into a recurrent hidden-state model (Mamba) using distillation methods like MOHAWK.
Demonstrates practical applications of the recurrent model in terms of throughput, memory efficiency, and edge-device deployment.
